class.name: VAVisualisation
class.description: Renders an emitter's visualisation rays as fading diamond sprites, one per ray bounce. Must be added as a direct child of a [VAEmitter] (or a node that inherits from it, such as [VASource] or [VAListener]) - it registers itself against that parent and drives its ray_count/bounce_count/update_frequency_ms properties. Every update_frequency_ms milliseconds, the parent emitter reports new ray bounce positions and normals, which are drawn as diamonds that fade in, hold, then fade out over fade_in_ms/duration_ms/fade_out_ms.

members.member: The number of visualisation rays to cast from the parent emitter. Mirrors the parent emitter's visualisation_ray_count.
The maximum number of bounces per visualisation ray. Mirrors the parent emitter's visualisation_bounce_count.
The interval, in milliseconds, between visualisation ray updates. Mirrors the parent emitter's visualisation_update_frequency.
How long, in milliseconds, each diamond takes to fade in from transparent to color's alpha after it first appears.
How long, in milliseconds, each diamond takes to fade out to transparent at the end of its lifetime.
How long, in milliseconds, each diamond remains visible in total, including fade_in_ms and fade_out_ms.
The colour of each diamond. The alpha channel is the maximum opacity reached once a diamond has fully faded in.
The radius of each diamond, in world units.
How far, in world units, each diamond is pushed off the surface it landed on along the hit normal. Increase this if diamonds z-fight with nearby world geometry.
Ray bounces further than this distance from the parent emitter are not rendered. Set to 0 to render bounces at any distance.
